t: Future-Proofing Your Brain: Vim, Nix, and the Cybernetic Workshop
s: This article proposes a 'Forever Machine' architecture using NixOS, Vim, and AI to create an adaptable, resilient personal cybernetic workshop, blending stateful journaling (Turing Machine) with functional AI processing (Church Machine) to future-proof cognitive mastery.
sub: NixOS for a self-contained, adaptable Cybernetic Workshop
Hybrid AI: Local (Twiki) & Frontier (Dr. Theopolis) interaction
Digital Immortality via owned data and modular AI
